platform_independence.principle: Wissenswerk is specified through open repository contracts, CLI JSON, tool manifests, and MCP. IDE-specific files are generated adapters only.

capabilities.ragprep_import: Import pre-chunked corpora without duplicating parsing logic.
capabilities.retrieval: PostgreSQL pgvector default with legacy Chroma adapter retained for Siebenwind.
capabilities.providers: OpenAI-compatible chat, summary, embedding, and rerank profiles.
capabilities.automation: Auto-apply wiki generation with reports, provenance, and rollback hints.
capabilities.bot: Discord adapter over the same Orakel/search interface.
